title.zh: theSVG · 适合查找并获取品牌与云服务

description.zh: 具体条目内容细节展示。 theSVG 提供可搜索的品牌 SVG 图标库，首页列出 Brand Icons、Auth Badges、AWS Architecture、Azure Services、Google Cloud、Kubernetes 等集合，并可按 family 浏览 Google、Microsoft、Adobe 等品牌。站点还提供 Docs、Submit Icon、Viewer 入口，以及 npm、编辑器扩展、设计工具、AI 与自动化等扩展入口。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by theSVG (https://thesvg.org/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。


Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
